deadline.value: The priority deadline is December 15, 2026 and the final deadline January 15, 2027, for Fall 2027 entry.

gre_general.value: The department does not require any GRE scores for a complete application.
gre_general.quote: We do not require any GRE scores as part of a complete application.

gre_subject.value: No GRE subject test is required.
gre_subject.quote: We do not require any GRE scores as part of a complete application.

toefl_min.value: Scores from 80 to 100 on the iBT are eligible, and the department calls 100 competitive.
toefl_min.quote: Candidates with a score between 80 and 100 (Internet-based test) or a IELTS score above 7.0 are also eligible

ielts_min.value: The FAQ calls 7.5 the competitive IELTS level; the admissions page also accepts scores above 7.0.
ielts_min.quote: To be competitive, candidates taking the IELTS should have a minimum score of 7.5

also.quote: a IELTS score above 7.0 are also eligible

supervisor.value: Applicants are encouraged to review faculty websites and reach out to faculty before applying.
supervisor.quote: We encourage you to browse the websites of our faculty and reach out to them to learn more about current areas of research and active projects.

funding.value: Students in good standing are guaranteed financial assistance for a full five years.
funding.quote: Graduate students who remain in good standing are guaranteed financial assistance for a full 5 years.

entry_route.value: The pages do not say whether a bachelor's applicant can enter directly.
